phase_name: NixOS-Safe Local Build Rehearsal and Parity Diff

objectives.description: Enter nix develop, create isolated venv in $TMPDIR, pip install build/twine/check-wheel-contents
cd code && python -m build; confirm model_checker-1.3.0 artifacts, not bimodal_logic
pip download model-checker==1.2.12; diff RECORD/file listings; sha256; classify deltas
Write rehearsal evidence: build.log, wheel-contents.txt, twine-check.txt, parity-diff.md

approaches_tried.approach: pip install build/twine/check-wheel-contents into venv without --no-user
approaches_tried.reason: ~/.config/pip/pip.conf sets install.user=true globally on NixOS; venv rejects --user installs. Fixed with PIP_USER=0 and --no-user flags.

approaches_tried.approach: Running venv setup and build in separate Bash tool calls, relying on an exported TMPDIR persisting across calls
approaches_tried.reason: Each Bash tool call is a fresh shell; exported env vars do not persist across calls, and `nix develop` additionally rewrites TMPDIR to a fresh per-invocation nix-shell.XXXXXX subdirectory each time it starts, so a venv created in one invocation is gone by the next. Fixed by doing the entire venv+build+check+download+diff sequence inside one nix develop invocation via a single script file.
